opening.argument: The presentation solicits purchases of mining pools by contrasting a cryptocurrency purchase with a pool that allegedly produces repeated Bitcoin output. It states that a $3,500 pool can produce about one Bitcoin and displays a multi-year Bitcoin production projection, while another slide links an Ethereum pool to stated generation and future valuation examples. The opportunity is also tied to a referral marketing system, commissions, and claimed daily earnings reaching $1,000. The speaker presents participation as hands-off and highly lucrative, then qualifies the claims by saying they are not guarantees and that some participants may make nothing. Those disclaimers do not remove the central solicitation built around substantial conditional returns from Bitcoin and Ethereum pools.
